artifacts.summary: Confirms guard-side (result mode, exit-code discipline, pgrep prohibition) and bounded-waiter infrastructure already exist; identifies the four unmethoded build_passed/verdict/PID-source gaps, the waiter-teardown wiring gap, and the git-snapshot --no-revert gap, with recommended pointer-based edits to each of the five in-scope files.

memory_candidates.content: Source-store convention: a build-verdict/process-liveness contract fix should be phrased as pointer-based additions to existing anchor files (e.g. long-builds.md's evidence hierarchy, bounded-build-waiter.md's waiter idiom, dispatch-report-not-termination.md's teardown rule) rather than restated per call site. Before writing new prose, grep the target files for the claimed gap (e.g. 'build_passed', 'pgrep', 'no-revert') to confirm what infrastructure is already present versus what a dispatch description merely asserts is missing -- an absorbed/merged task description can overstate or slightly mis-scope an existing sibling agent's coverage (e.g. claiming a general orchestrator_mode bullet exists when only a narrower context-pressure-gated instance does).
